manifest.name: dsh-wsl-terraform
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness WSL plugin: terraform/tofu plan summary + state list (never apply).

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: dsh-wsl-terraform
      name: dsh-wsl-terraform
      config:
        enabled: true
        timeoutMs: 180000
        allowRoots: []

declared.name: tf_status
declared.description: Whether terraform or tofu is on PATH; preferred binary + version.

declared.name: tf_validate_probe
declared.description: terraform/tofu validate -no-color (read-only dry probe). Never applies.

declared.name: tf_plan_summary
declared.description: terraform/tofu plan -no-color (read-only). Returns Plan: add/change/destroy counts + capped output. Never applies.
